label: Shopee Service Partners
terms_note: ISV requires a registered enterprise licence; Open Platform agreement.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Open Platform ISV APIs — operate sellers' shops; no client-finding API). Lane `human` → **keep**. Confidence medium.
auth: 1. Register as ISV (registered enterprise) → partner_id / partner_key → shop authorization.

endpoints.purpose: service delivery for a client's shop

reference.limits: - Partner gate; no marketplace of jobs. - ISV requires a registered enterprise licence; Open Platform agreement.

reason: The Shopee Open Platform (https://open.shopee.com/documents, opened 2026-09-25) serves registered ISVs (enterprise registration → partner_id/partner_key, HMAC-signed calls and per-shop authorisation) to operate authorised sellers' shops (shop, product, order, logistics APIs). There is no endpoint that lists merchants seeking service partners or lets a partner bid for work, so no deals verb maps, and access is partner-gated.
